name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 11 times in 4 visits over 37 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 22 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 15 hours starting 2025-07-01, at wavelengths from 1.66 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
